\section{Professional Summary}
\small{
Full-stack engineer with 6+ years of production experience at Mastercard, now applying that engineering discipline to machine learning systems. At the Nebius AI Engineering Fellowship, I built MLOps pipelines for distributed LLM training on H100 clusters, implemented a dataflow integrity check that validates every agent output against tool-call logs to catch hallucinations automatically, and optimized LLM inference \textbf{6.69x} through KV caching. Strong Python and Go fundamentals; hands-on with Docker, Kubernetes, and observability tooling (Grafana, OpenTelemetry) for monitoring and regression tracking. I write technical articles on LLM observability and evaluation, and I am completing an MSc in Computer Science at Queen Mary University of London.
}
